content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: high 5xx spike from model-runner pool r-quant-3 in us-west-2. Error signature: repeated SIGSEGV in libattention_quant.so (recent deploy rolled 02:10 UTC). Incident page: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-457

maria: oncall here, looking. can someone confirm customer impact (errors per min, top routes)?
devon: seeing ~18% 5xx on /v1/generate for model=rex-7b-quant, latency up. Gateway 502 + 504 timeouts. Affected capacity ~22% of runner pool.
jin: grabbing core dumps from crashed hosts, attaching ld.so logs. running gcore on pid 1223 now.
sasha: customer impact tracker: 14 customers with >5% error rate; top is analytics-platform (prod) showing retries. Marking sev-2 for now.
emily: rollback candidate is rex-7b-int8:v2026-03-02 (previous kernel). can we reroute traffic to v2026-02-27 fallback model?
devon: starting traffic shadow -> fallback model, will flip 10% -> 50% if stable. updating routing policy.
ops-bot: playbook link: https://internal.playbooks/redwood/runtime-segfault. Suggest isolation of quant kernel and restart of affected pods with env REDWOOD_KERN_DEBUG=1
maria: good. jin — collect /var/log/syslog + dmesg from the three crash hosts and put in /tmp/INC-457. keep them online for now
jin: done, uploaded tar: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/INC-457/cores-3750009999.tar.gz
andrew: quick check: telemetry shows spike in long-seq requests (seq_len > 8k tokens) to rex-7b-quant around same window. could be KVCACHE growth causing mmap fragmentation.
emily: try enabling per-request token cap at edge: max_tokens=4096 for rex-7b-quant until we get root cause. can we inject on gateway?
devon: rolled token cap via route override for rex-7b-quant. will monitor 1m.
sasha: pinging customer success for top 5 customers to notify and provide mitigation steps.
maria: monitoring: 5xx rate falling to 6% after 30m but still elevated vs baseline 0.7%. cores show same stacktrace: libattention_quant::attn_kernel+0x1b4 -> segfault.
jin: we've reproduced locally on a quantized build with long sequences. creating repro test and filing bug: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-9921
emily: schedule hotfix: rebuild quant kernel with bounds checks, run canary on two nodes, then roll forward. estimated 2-3 hours.
andrew: as interim, continuing fallback routing + token cap should protect most customers. operations: would like ephemeral increase of dedicated fallback capacity to absorb load, can we spin up 4 extra nodes?
devon: provisioning + labeling them fallback=true. routing now includes new nodes.
ops-bot: checklist: enable coredump collection, preserve nodes, capture perf traces, attach to ticket.
maria: paging update for exec: we'll keep this channel for live mitigation. next update in 15m or on major status change. :white_check_mark:
emily: note for postmortem: include prompt patterns that create long context and quantization interaction. add eval harness for longseq-quant tests.
sasha: outreach: CS notified 7 impacted accounts, drafting status message.
jin: attaching minimal repro script in ticket; include env: CUDA 12.1, driver 545, qkernel v1.9.
devon: confirming 5xx now ~1.2% and decreasing. no new segfaults in last 10m on active nodes.
maria: thanks team. after hotfix deploy we'll run a longer soak and then close incident.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-457 updated: mitigation in progress, status: monitoring. Incident timeline: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-457/timeline
